entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with Isaac at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need a return label. Order number is 774-B-91.
I can certainly help you with that. Let me just pull up your order. Okay, I see the VeloBand GPS Tracker delivered on December 15th. To get started, what specifically is the issue with the band?
No issue. I just don't need it. I already tried to return this weeks ago and your website was broken. Just send the label.
I'm very sorry to hear you had trouble with our site. Can you tell me when you first tried to process the return?
Around December 24th. There was a major website error, the whole return system was down. I have a screenshot of the error page. I couldn't print the label or even start the process.

Thank you for that information, that's very helpful. Let me check my records for that date. ... Yes, I do see a note in our system about a service outage that day. My apologies for that inconvenience. Let me just review the return eligibility for you.
Okay, I've looked it up. You're all set. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery, so you're well within that timeframe. The website issue was our fault entirely.
Good. So you're emailing me the label?

Yes, I'm generating it right now. I've just sent that prepaid label to the email we have on file. And because you're a VIP member and had to deal with that system down frustration, I've also added a $50 store credit to your account. You can use that on any future VeloFit purchase.
Okay. The label and a credit. That's fine. Thank you.
You are very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
